messages:
nora.product: Quick sync request 9:30 PT tomorrow to decide launch criteria for Evidence Export MVP. Need to lock scope: export formats, retention rules, BYOK requirements, and pricing buckets. Thoughts?

kai.eng: i'm +1. main constraints: streaming export for >50M rows, resumable uploads, and a backfill path for archived partitions. we should define a max single-file size and recommend parquet+gz chunks.

sanjay.security: must require integrity proofs. every export needs a manifest that lists parts + sha256 and a server signature. BYOK for Dedicated customers only; hosted customers get envelope-encrypted exports via our KMS. we should also document threat model for chain-of-custody.

alisa.legal: need explicit contract text for retention tiers (default 30 days, extended 365, long-term 7k) and what triggers retention-change notifications. legal-hold semantics: customer-created holds must prevent deletion and produce an audit entry. also include a subpoena assist clause.

ben.sales: enterprise customers ask for a premium "rush export" lane. pricing proposal: included exports per month; overage for premium lane by GB or by parallelism units. sales needs sample price bands to pitch.

tess.sre: ops concerns: queue starvation if many premium jobs hit at once. suggest capacity caps per-tenant and tenant-prioritization knobs. also need export-runbook + alerts for failed checksums.

deploy-bot: Deploy:export-service v2.4 deployed to staging  tests green: https://ci.redwood.ai/exp/987

nora.product: proposal to team: ship MVP with 
  - formats: parquet, jsonl
  - modes: standard (queued, 48h), expedited (queue priority + parallel, 6h up to 100GB)
  - retention: 30/365/7000 days options
  - security: hosted=KMS envelope, dedicated=BYOK/HSM support (phase 2)
  - artifacts: signed manifest + sha256 per chunk
  - UI: cost estimate and cross-region consent checkbox
  - legal: legal-hold API + audit entries
are we comfortable with this scope for MVP?

kai.eng: technically reasonable. caveats: expedited SLA depends on available Dedicated capacity; for hosted expedite we'll implement soft caps (e.g., max 5 concurrent expedited exports per region) and queue fallback. will document retry & resume behaviour.

sanjay.security: add requirement: manifests must include server cert fingerprint and an expirer timestamp. for BYOK flow we need a handshake spec: upload wrapped key + proof of possession.

alisa.legal: clarify: legal-hold API requires an auditable owner field and must accept a signed token from customer's legal admin. include retention-change notice window (30 days) in contract.

ben.sales: request: add an example contract excerpt we can share with customers for pricing and legal-hold language. also want a one-pager for sales engineers.

tess.sre: SLOs: export success rate 99.5% (monthly), 95th p90 latency targets for standard and expedited. alert thresholds: >10% failed exports in 1h or backlog growth >30% vs baseline.

nora.product: owners & ETA:
  - kai.eng: API + resumable spec + example clients (curl + python)  due 2026-05-04
  - sanjay.security: manifest spec, BYOK handshake doc, threat model  due 2026-04-29
  - tess.sre: ops runbook, SLOs, dashboard mockups  due 2026-05-06
  - alisa.legal: contract snippets + retention-change clause  due 2026-04-30
  - ben.sales: sales one-pager + pricing bands  due 2026-05-08

kai.eng: sample curl for kickoff will be in spec, e.g.:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/exports \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"tenant":"org-456","range":{"start":"2025-07-01","end":"2025-12-31"},"format":"parquet","mode":"expedited"}'
```

sanjay.security: sample manifest fields we'll require: export_id, tenant, created_at, parts [{id, size, sha256}], signature, server_cert_fingerprint. no PII in manifest.

alisa.legal: also include clear deletion flow for ephemeral exports: default TTL 14 days unless customer requests archival retrieval with separate pricing. legal-hold pins until release.

ben.sales: edge-case asks from customers: 1) split-subtenant exports 2) incremental exports (only deltas) 3) signed evidence package for auditors. can we support incremental by date-window?

kai.eng: incremental deltas = doable via change-stream cursors; will include in roadmap but not MVP. split-subtenant: add support if tenant has subspace tag; include sample query param.

tess.sre: cross-region note: require customer consent banner for EU->US transfers and log consent event. integrate with Console checkbox.

nora.product: ok team, sounds like consensus. I'll prepare the workshop doc and invite Sales + Support + Legal for 2026-04-05 14:00 PT. please flag any blockers in the spec PR. :thumbsup:
